# DECISION STUB — External SDK Resilience

> ⚠️ Generated stub. Copy vào `docs/decisions/2026-10-09-external-sdk-resilience.md` trước khi edit.

## Context

**Detected reason:** 6 distinct third-party STT/LLM/inference SDKs vượt threshold (>2):
nvidia-riva, soniox, openai, sherpa-onnx, mlx-audio, onnxruntime — 18 import sites
(tập trung `core`: `stt.py` 10, `local_stt.py` 3; rải `translate.py`, `summarize.py`,
`diarize.py`, `api/diagnose.py`, `local/device_detect.py`).

**Detected patterns:**

- Lazy imports trong function body để tránh startup cost (`stt.py`, `diagnose.py:247`,
  `main.py:217`) — che coupling, khó grep exhaustive.
- Mỗi provider có failure semantics riêng: Riva reconnect-backoff, Soniox terminal-error
  frame (fix v1.2.15), local guard Tier A — không có abstraction chung.
- Keys phân tán: `db.settings` + 5 env vars (`NVIDIA_API_KEY`, `SONIOX_API_KEY`,
  `LLM_API_KEY`, `LLM_MODEL`, `LLM_BASE_URL`); TLS frozen-bundle fix thủ công (`certifi`).
- `summarize.py` → `api.settings._PROVIDER_URLS` (core→api ngược chiều).
